accountMissingBody: This recipient came from your setup chat without account details. Kassa will not pay it until its account details are added and verified.

add.coolingNote: A new or changed recipient cools down for 24 hours before you can pay it.

errors.ACH_ACCOUNT_INVALID: A US account number has 4 to 17 digits.
errors.ACH_ROUTING_INVALID: This routing number's check digit is wrong. It has 9 digits.
errors.ALIPAY_ID_INVALID: Use the email or the 11-digit mainland mobile number on their Alipay account.
errors.IBAN_INVALID: This IBAN's check digits don't add up. Check it for a typo.
errors.INVALID_IBAN: This IBAN's check digits don't add up. Check it for a typo.
errors.NAME_MISSING: Enter the name on their account.
errors.SCHEME_CURRENCY_MISMATCH: Alipay and UnionPay receive CNY, US bank accounts receive USD, and IBAN accounts receive the other currencies.
errors.UNIONPAY_CARD_INVALID: This isn't a valid UnionPay card number. It starts with 62 and has 16 to 19 digits.
errors.KASSA_ID_INVALID: A Kassa ID looks like KSA-7QMX-2HVA: 8 letters and digits after KSA.
errors.KASSA_ID_SELF: That's your own Kassa ID. Top up from Home instead.
errors.KASSA_ID_UNKNOWN: No Kassa user has this ID. Ask them to read it from Settings.
errors.DETAILS_CATEGORY_MISMATCH: These details don't fit this kind of recipient.
errors.KNP_INVALID: A KNP code is 3 digits, for example 311 for wages.

add.name: Name on the account
add.title: Add recipient

nameFor.RENT: Landlord or dorm, as on their account

coolingRule: You can pay this recipient once the 24 hours are over.
explainerBody: Changing a recipient's account details creates a new recipient. A changed account is treated as a brand-new recipient that cools down for 24 hours before it can be paid.
newPayeeExplainer: This is a new recipient. It cools down for 24 hours before any payment can go to it.
notFound: This recipient could not be found.
title: Recipients

IBAN.hint: Within Europe (SEPA) the name and IBAN are all a bank needs. Spaces are fine.

CN_ALIPAY.hint: Paid straight to their Alipay balance, in CNY. Use the email or phone number on their Alipay account.

CN_UNIONPAY.hint: Paid to the bank account behind their UnionPay debit card, in CNY.

US_ACH.hint: An ACH transfer needs the 9-digit routing number and the account number. Both are printed on a US check.

KASSA_USER.hint: Another Kassa user's wallet, by their Kassa ID (Settings → Your Kassa ID). Any currency, arrives in minutes.

OTHER.hint: A merchant ID or an account Kassa can't check, for QR handoffs. Bank transfers can't reach it.

categoryHint.PEOPLE: Family, friends, wages for someone who works for you
categoryHint.TUITION: Your school or university, matched by your student ID
categoryHint.RENT: Your landlord or dorm, every month
categoryHint.SHOPS: Shops and cafés you pay by card or QR

details.purposeCodeHint: Kazakh banks ask for it on transfers. 311 is wages, 119 transfers to family.
details.studentIdHint: The school matches your payment by it. It goes into every payment's reference.
details.portalUrlHint: The link your school gave you for paying fees (for example Flywire or the bursar's page).
details.rentReferenceHint: What your landlord wants to see in the reference.
details.dueDayHint: Day of the month rent is due (1 to 28).
details.customerNumberHint: Printed on your bill. The company matches your payment by it.
details.billReference: Reference (if the bill asks for one)

actions.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}}? You can add them again later, but they will cool down for 24 hours.

edit.title: Edit details
edit.note: Changing these doesn't change where the money goes, so there is no new cooling period. To change the account, add a new recipient.

schedule.title: Set up a schedule
schedule.body: Kassa plans this payment and asks you (or pays inside a signed mandate) when it is due.
schedule.created: Schedule created. You'll find it in Bills.
schedule.dateInvalid: Use a date like 2026-11-01, today or later.

school.title: Find your school
school.body: Pick your school and enter your student ID and date of birth. The school confirms it's you, then Kassa fetches your invoice and adds it as a bill, with the exact amount and reference.
school.noneFound: No school matches that. You can add it by hand instead.
school.directoryNote: The school list and invoices come from the schools' payment portals. In this demo they are fictitious schools.
school.manual: My school isn't listed: enter its details by hand
school.dateOfBirthHint: As your school has it on file (YYYY-MM-DD). The school checks it; Kassa doesn't keep it.
school.noInvoices: There is no open invoice for this student right now.
school.willAdd: Kassa adds the school as a recipient (paid to the account the school lists) and the invoice as a bill. Like every new recipient, it cools down for 24 hours first.
school.existing: You already pay this school. Kassa links it to the school's portal and adds any invoice that isn't a bill yet.
school.billAdded_one: The invoice is now a bill in Bills.
school.billAdded_other: {{count}} invoices are now bills in Bills.

errors.STUDENT_ID_INVALID: A student ID is 4 to 20 letters, digits or dashes.
errors.SCHOOL_DIRECTORY_UNAVAILABLE: The school directory isn't answering. Try again in a moment.
errors.STUDENT_NOT_VERIFIED: The school couldn't confirm this student. Check your student ID and date of birth.
errors.DATE_OF_BIRTH_INVALID: Enter your date of birth like 2005-03-14.
errors.SCHOOL_ACCOUNT_CHANGED: The school now lists a different bank account. Add the school again: it becomes a new recipient and cools down for 24 hours.
